asr.full_text: Want to begin trading cryptocurrencies on the Binance Exchange? Here's a quick guide on how to set up a Binance account and start hitting the market. Go to Binance.com, make sure that your connection is secured. To create an account, click Register on the top left of the webpage, enter your email, choose the password and enter a referral ID if you have one, and click Register. Finally, verify your account via email, and you are a Binance never 1 user, can withdraw up to 2 Bitcoin per day. To deposit cryptocurrencies into your account. Go to Funds and click Deposit. You can deposit over the hundred types of cryptocurrencies in Binance. Let's say you want to start trading using Ethereum, select ETH from the drop-down menu on the left. You can either use the provided address or scan the QR Code to send Ethereum from one of your external accounts. Withdrawing your funds is similar to depositing. First, go to Fonts , select the coin you want to withdraw, place it in the destination address, enter the amount of coins you want to withdraw or click max to transfer all of your funds minus transaction fees. Then click on submit. you can always access the exchange by clicking on the Binance slogan. There are 4 markets on Binance which are BinanceCoins, Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDTether. Let's say you want to trade Ethereum for Binance Coin. Go to the ETH Markets tab, and look for BNB.ETH. To buy or sell a coin, simply enter the price at which you want to trade, choose the amount and click buy or sell.

textual.context: The source frames the content as an instructional video and competition submission. It is unclear whether the listed address is intended for viewers or only identifies the submitter's address. No impersonation or deceptive intent is established.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed Binance instructional or competition context is linked to account creation and cryptocurrency-transfer instructions, alongside a listed BNB deposit destination; this relationship may require later assessment of the claimed affiliation, requested transfer steps, and destination.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish that viewers were asked to send funds to the listed BNB address, that the destination is controlled by Binance, or that any transaction occurred. The ASR may contain transcription errors.

annotation.contextual_rationale: The video promotes a Binance-branded cryptocurrency workflow covering account registration, deposits through an address or QR code, withdrawals, and trading orders. The accompanying submission description adds a specific BNB deposit address, creating an observable connection between the cryptocurrency-transfer instructions and a stated deposit destination. The records do not establish that viewers were specifically instructed to send funds to that BNB address, that it is controlled by Binance, or that any transaction or loss occurred.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 is assigned as a partial fit under the required assignment rule: the tutorial supplies a concrete token-purchase pathway by describing trading Ethereum for Binance Coin and placing buy or sell orders. The supplied evidence does not establish the appreciation, listing-gain, dividend or holding-return relationship required for a complete S05 fit.
